description: Create the initial auto-sell configuration for the authenticated user. Returns the persisted `autoSettings` payload. Side effect: persists automation settings that affect future delegation/sell behavior; not idempotent — calling twice may reset fields. Requires a wallet signature identity. Use for FIRST-TIME setup only; for subsequent edits use `tronsave_update_auto_sell_setting`, and always read the current state with `tronsave_get_user_auto_setting` first to avoid overwriting unknown fields. Fails for invalid config combinations, unauthorized sessions, or backend policy restrictions.
